tokens.name: Bio Protocol
tokens.usageLine: You may hold, buy, sell and use this token. Use it only in permissible activities.
tokens.pubWhat: The token of Bio Protocol, a platform that funds and launches science research projects.
tokens.pubWhy: It is used for governance and access to research launches. No prohibited products were found.
tokens.pubHow: You may hold, buy, sell, stake and use it. Join only launches of permissible projects.
tokens.pubKnow: Tokens of individual research projects are separate assets.
tokens.basis: DeSci funding platform governance token; Row 6 H1.

tokens.name: ThorChain
tokens.usageLine: You may hold, buy, sell and use this token. Use it only in permissible activities.
tokens.pubWhat: The coin of THORChain, a network for swapping Bitcoin and other coins across blockchains.
tokens.pubWhy: Its value comes mainly from swap fees.
tokens.pubHow: You may hold, buy, sell and use it for swaps and liquidity pools.
tokens.pubKnow: Its lending service failed in 2025 and the network was hacked in 2026.

tokens.name: Jito Staked SOL
tokens.usageLine: You may hold, buy, sell and use this token. Use it only in permissible activities.
tokens.pubWhat: A token you receive for staking SOL with Jito's staking pool on Solana.
tokens.pubWhy: Its earnings come from rewards for helping run the Solana network, not from lending.
tokens.pubHow: You may hold, buy, sell and use it.

tokens.name: Staked FRAX Ether
tokens.usageLine: Do not hold, buy or trade it. If you hold it, exit.
tokens.pubWhat: A token you receive for depositing ETH with Frax Finance, which grows as the deposit earns.
tokens.pubWhy: Frax lends the ETH deposited with it to validator operators, who pay interest for it.
tokens.pubHow: Do not buy or hold it. If you hold it, exit.

tokens.name: ETH.fi
tokens.usageLine: Insufficient information for a clear decision. Avoid holding or trading it until more is known.
tokens.pubWhat: The token of ether.fi, a staking platform that now offers a crypto card and savings vaults.
tokens.pubWhy: Part of the platform's revenue is paid to token stakers.
tokens.pubHow: Avoid holding or trading it until more is known.
tokens.pubKnow: The card lets users borrow at interest, which is not permissible.
